book.name: 1 TESALONIKA
book.title: 1 TESALONIKA Tesalonika mbal tuku waŋe Paulusŋge amboŋga kuyarna

content: Sine maŋau purfeŋnu ŋak minbe

O tira kame, sine Suŋgo Yesus tuku nyu mbolŋge tane wam ande kam tuku sarsartiŋgamŋgig. Sine o buk tane ndoŋ minmba mine maŋau Kuate nzalite ta tumtiŋgigeŋ le tane kila pilmba kile taŋamba minig. Tane mine maŋau ta lato lato kumba minap ŋga satiŋgeg.
Sine Suŋgo Yesus tuku nyu mbolŋge tane wam pagu pasa satiŋgigeŋ ta tane kila.
Tane purfeŋnu minap ta Kuate tuku nzali. Tane fare fare taŋgo pino ndoŋ une ndaka
maŋau tiŋreknumbi pino kilap.
Nane Kuate gilai mbal naŋgine ŋgarosu tuku nzali mbolŋge pino fare fare kilig taŋamba ke ndakap.
Tane taŋgine tira ande lukamba nu tuku pino didika nale muŋgu kilik wam ta pur ndanikap. Nane taŋamba kade mbal ta Suŋgo nu lafunu niŋgamŋgat. Sine riroŋ pasa ta buk satiŋgigeŋ le tane isnaig.
Kuate nu sine wikina ta kutur ŋak minbe ŋga wi ndakina. Nu sine purfeŋnu minbe ŋga wikina.
Ande nu wam pagu pasa te pitaikate ta nu taŋgo tuku miŋge pitai ndate. Nu Kuate Tukul Guwa siŋgit nu tuku miŋge pitaite.
Tane taŋgine taŋgine kume purkam tuku Kuateŋge tumtiŋgina. Ta tuku ye tane maŋau ta kap ŋga kuyar ndawet.
Tira kame Masedonia ma tugu mbolŋge mine likade ta tane nane ŋakmba tuku kume purkade. Taŋgine maŋau mayenu ta ndo lato lato kap.
Tane ŋgan mine maŋau mbolŋge minam tuku wamdus saŋgrinu palpe. Taŋgine wam ndo idusniŋmba afu tuku wam kuer ndakap. Tane ake mine ndaka waimbi pirokap. Sine buk taŋamba tane wam pagutiŋgigeŋ.
Tane taŋamba pirokap ta Yesus dubi ndade mbal tane kaŋgerka tane tuku saka minamŋgaig. Maŋau ta mbolŋge taŋgine ŋgarosu kulatka afu piti serniŋge nda.
Suŋgo nu luka prowamŋgat

O tira kame, tane kumig mbal tuku wamdus mbarbekaig ŋga sine tane kila satiŋgamŋgig. Mbal afu Yesus ndoŋ minam tuku idus ndamba naŋgine kumig mbal ta tuku malmbika piti suŋgo tade. Tane taŋgine kumig mbal tuku malmbi suŋgo ndawap.
Yesus nu kummba aboŋgina ta sine son ŋgeg. Taŋamba ndo Yesus son ŋga kumig mbal nane Kuateŋge kile-tidiŋguwa le Yesus ndoŋ prowamŋgaig ta sine mata son ŋgeg.
Sine kile pasa satiŋgamŋgig te Suŋgo tuku pasa. Suŋgo nu prowa le sine kilke te mbolŋge abo ŋak mineg mbal kumanu mbal kile-ŋgumnemke nda. Kuga.
Wi saŋgri mayok kuwa le eŋel kame tuku gabat nu wikuwa le Kuate tuku tabil fudukuwa le Suŋgo nu samba mbolŋge ndekamŋgat. Ndekuwa le nane Kristus son ŋga kumig mbal amboŋga tiŋgamŋgaig.

Nane taŋawaig le kilke te mbolŋge son ŋga mineg mbal sine ŋakmba kilmba kile-duŋguwa le gau mbol ambeŋge kumig mbal ndoŋ ulendika kumba Yesus tugumŋge maŋgurkamŋgig. Taŋabe sulumba sine Suŋgo ndoŋ mara mindek minmba minamŋgig.
Tane pasa tembi taŋgine taŋgine wamdus piti kile-ibeŋkap.
